Many have come to this village to view the shell of cruma, but I have rarely seen anyone return from that place intact. The Ma…

guard/30073-1.htm.text: Guard Jacob: Crumas were a mystical race of beings, one of the first animals to be created in the beginning. They looked like turtles, and there were four crumas in all. Now they have all disappeared and only their shells remain, so we can only imagine what they must have been like. I have heard tr…

guard/30073-2.htm.text: Guard Jacob: The marshlands are where the cruma's shell is, so they are called the the Cruma Marshlands. The Marshlands are beyond that temple over there. If you keep walking north, you can easily find them. However, there are rarely people there and the place is swarming with frightening monsters.…

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30073-01.htm.text: Jacob: Did I see anyone suspicious? Not that I remember. Go ask Harlan over there.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30073-01a.ht.text: Jacob: I haven't seen anyone suspicious. Go ask Harlan over there if he has.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30073-02.htm.text: Jacob: Harlan didn't see anything either? Hmm... If there is anyone like you describe, he will soon attract the attention of our chief of security, Lucas. I would go talk to him, if I were you. You will find him at the south side castle gate.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30073-03.htm.text: Jacob: I haven't seen anyone suspicious. If there is anyone like you describe, however, he will soon attract the attention of our chief of security, Lucas. I would go talk to him, if I were you. You will find him at the south side castle gate.

Q00330_AdeptOfTaste/30073-04.html.text: Guard Jacob: Please continue, then. Royal Jelly is an ingredient that is contained only within worker bees that are less than a week old, and it will be hard to find. But it is worth all the bother it takes to obtain this. Honey that contains Royal Jelly cannot compare in taste to ordinary honey.
